title: stillingia laurocerasus
intro: Stillingia laurocerasus, commonly known as Queen's Delight or King's Crown, is a plant native to the southeastern United States. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, and treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Stillingia laurocerasus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include stilnol, laurocerasusine, and other triterpenoids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
